Copyright · database rights · use

Original work. Clear boundaries.

London Advanced is shared for people to use, not for others to copy, scrape, repackage or train systems on. These terms protect the original photography, writing, visual identity, code, curated data and tool experiences while preserving lawful quotation, linking and other rights granted by law.

Effective 25 October 2026
01Ownership

Unless a page says otherwise, the original photographs, writing, editing, maps and graphics created for the project, page layouts, visual look and feel, interface copy, source code, tool interfaces, original taxonomies, and the selection and arrangement of the London Advanced databases are © 2026 Paolo Pastorino. All rights are reserved.

Copyright protects the expression of the work, including code and design. Database right and/or database copyright may protect a substantial investment in obtaining, verifying and presenting the collections. An abstract idea, method or mathematical concept is not owned merely by stating copyright; protection instead applies to the original code, specifications, interfaces, content, datasets and their selection or arrangement, together with these contractual conditions of access.

02What you may do
  • Browse and use the public site and tools for personal, non-commercial planning.
  • Link to a public page and share its URL.
  • Quote a short passage for criticism, review, reporting or academic work where the law permits, with clear attribution to Paolo Pastorino and a link to the source.
  • Use anything else only with prior written permission or under a separate written licence.
03What is not licensed

Except where the law expressly permits it, you may not:

  • copy, republish, sell, sublicense, mirror or create a substitute service from the photographs, text, design, code or tool output;
  • scrape, crawl, harvest, download or extract the databases or results in bulk, including through repeated queries;
  • reproduce the site’s distinctive interface, editorial structure, taxonomies or presentation in a confusingly similar product;
  • reverse engineer, circumvent access controls or rate limits, interfere with the service, or use undocumented automated access;
  • remove copyright, credit, source or rights notices;
  • use the content, photographs, code, data or tool output to train, fine-tune, evaluate or ground a generative-AI or machine-learning system, build a retrieval corpus, or create a commercial dataset without prior written permission.

No licence is granted merely because source material or a public URL can be viewed. Any legally non-excludable exception remains unaffected.

04Data, algorithms and external material

London Advanced’s editorial ratings, descriptions, tags, location curation, verification work, scoring configurations and compiled records form part of its protected content and databases. Public results are for the visitor’s immediate use; they are not an API or a licence to reconstruct the underlying data or logic.

Transport, weather, map, venue and other third-party data remain subject to the rights and terms of their respective owners. Names, logos and trade marks belonging to venues, providers or platforms remain theirs. Inclusion does not imply affiliation or endorsement. “London Advanced” and its identifying graphics may not be used in a way that suggests sponsorship, approval or origin.

05Accuracy, availability and responsibility

The site and tools provide independent editorial and planning information, not safety, legal, medical, financial, accessibility or official travel advice. Live conditions, opening hours, prices, routes and external data can change. Check the relevant official source before relying on a result.

The service is provided without a promise that it will always be available, error-free or suitable for a particular purpose. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, or affects mandatory consumer rights.

06Copyright concerns and corrections

Paolo wants to correct genuine errors and rights issues. If you believe material on the site infringes your copyright or another right, use the contact form and provide: your name and contact details; the work concerned; the exact London Advanced URL; the basis of your claim; and the amendment, credit or removal requested.

A credible notice will be reviewed promptly. Content may be restricted temporarily while the facts are checked, then corrected, credited, removed or restored as appropriate. Deliberately false or misleading notices may cause harm, so submit claims in good faith.

07Permissions, changes and law

For republication, commercial use, research access, a data licence, syndication, photography use or tool integration, contact Paolo before use. These terms may change as the project develops; continued use after publication of revised terms applies from the revised effective date. The terms are governed by the law of England and Wales, without depriving consumers of mandatory protections available where they live.

These pages describe how the site currently works and may be updated when services or duties change. Use the contact form for a specific request.
